set.body:
Outcome: select condition-specific contour subsets with measured target separation and the declared linear matching constraints.

Scope: binary selection/assignment over whole contours, set-level aggregation as the primary mode, and per-drawing mode under the frozen contract. Implement L1 deviations with a valid linear formulation. Use the smallest justified solver dependency or bounded exact/search implementation; decide this after inspecting licensing, supported platforms, install burden, and benchmark size. Do not infer optimality from a heuristic or an incomplete solver run. Preserve stable contour IDs, user-supplied feature specifications, and deterministic tie behavior.

Acceptance:
- Compare returned assignments, objective values, and constraints against exhaustive enumeration on independent tiny problems, including ties and infeasibility.
- Independently recompute all claimed constraints and target scores from selected contours using the frozen specification, rather than trusting the solver matrix.
- Distinguish optimal, feasible with a bound/gap when available, proven infeasible, budget exhausted without a feasible solution, and invalid input. Capture actual time/memory and solver version/settings.
- Respect set-level and optional per-drawing constraints without forcing feasible-looking splits or silently relaxing tolerances.
- No transformation operations, junction/MAT optimization, or spatial coverage objective. Any heuristic fallback is explicit and carries no optimality certificate.
- Run the already-frozen benchmark without changing its fixtures, objective, or tolerances to obtain a win.
set.title: Implement whole-contour subset optimization with exact constraint verification
